main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when the supplied policy context subject is missing or does not match the required stage subject.

field.name: Subject
field.summary: Required subject string matched by this stage during evaluation.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a subject-match access-policy stage for a required subject string.
constructor.param: Required subject string. Value must not be null, empty, or whitespace.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether the supplied policy context subject matches the required stage subject.
method.returns: Deny when the subject is missing or does not match the required subject; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether the supplied policy context subject matches the required stage subject.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the subject is missing or does not match the required subject; otherwise allow.
